Messages.Author: Morgan Vening
Messages.Body:
This is for clarification within our group.

Nosferatu deck, Malkav Antitribu deck.

Nos deck plays Malkavian Dementia. Attempts to steal Hannibal (Malk
Anti Cardinal). Rule 10.2 only refers to requirements for playing a
card.

Excerpt 10.2. A vampire of one of the antitribu clans does not
qualify to play a card that requires the counterpart, and vice versa.

It would seem to intimate that it would also mean can't be the target
of said card also, but that kind of fell on deaf ears.

So, just for the record, there is no mechanical similarity between
Anarch Gangrel, Malkavian, and Malkavian antitribu. IE, the name is
nothing more than a label, and Malk-Antitribu could quite easily have
been called Sons of Dementia?

Morgan Vening

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Morgan Vening <mor...@optusnet.com.au> wrote:
> So, just for the record, there is no mechanical similarity between
> Anarch Gangrel, Malkavian, and Malkavian antitribu. IE, the name is
> nothing more than a label, and Malk-Antitribu could quite easily have
> been called Sons of Dementia?

"Anarch" has nothing to do with clan. An Anarch Gangrel, an Independent
Gangrel, and a Camarilla Gangrel (and a Gangrel turned Sabbat by Into the
Fire), are all Gangrel.

But a Gangrel Antitribu is *not* a Gangrel (even if the Gangrel Antitribu
has managed to join the Camarilla).
And a Gangrel is *not* a Gangrel Antitribu.

Same goes for all "Foo" and "Foo Antitribu".

Messages.Body:
